entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: New Phyrexia's Invasion Tree, a massive tree grown from World Tree tyrite that can merge planes; later Wrenn's partner Eight.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane that grew Realmbreaker in its Seedcore.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A planeswalker who bonded with Realmbreaker, named him Eight, and died from wielding his power.

entities.name: Seven
entities.description: Wrenn's earlier partner, who died during the Invasion.

entities.name: The World Tree
entities.description: The massive tree of Kaldheim, Realmbreaker's progenitor.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Phyrexian who took tyrite from the World Tree on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian leader who planned to use Realmbreaker to expand New Phyrexia across the Multiverse.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers who tried to destroy Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Filigree Sylex
entities.description: A device the Gatewatch planned to use to destroy Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who had been compleated and accelerated Realmbreaker's growth.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Found vivisected inside Realmbreaker, urging the Sylex's detonation.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: Planeswalker who hesitated to detonate the Sylex.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker who hesitated to detonate the Sylex.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who tried to detonate the Sylex.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who stopped Jace from detonating the Sylex.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Plane reached by Wrenn and Eight to displace New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: An angel of Capenna who flew out through the open Omenpaths.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of the multiverse in which Realmbreaker opened the way for the Machine Legion.

events.summary: Realmbreaker was grown in the Seedcore of New Phyrexia from tyrite taken from the World Tree.
events.quote: Realmbreaker was grown in the Seedcore , the innermost sphere of New Phyrexia

events.summary: The Gatewatch reached the Seedcore to destroy Realmbreaker, but the compleated Nissa had accelerated his growth to maturity.
events.quote: They were too late, as Nissa Revane had been compleated before they arrived

events.summary: Inside Realmbreaker the strike force found Karn vivisected; Kaya and Kaito hesitated to detonate the Sylex.
events.quote: Kaya Cassir and Kaito Shizuki hesitated to detonate the Sylex

events.summary: Jace attempted to detonate the Sylex but was stopped by Elspeth Tirel.
events.quote: Jace Beleren still attempted to do so, but was stopped by Elspeth Tirel .

events.summary: During the invasion, Realmbreaker's branches tore through the Blind Eternities, opening the way for the Machine Legion.
events.quote: Realmbreaker's branches tore through the Blind Eternities and opened the way for the Machine Legion to invade other planes.

events.summary: After losing Seven, Wrenn bonded with Realmbreaker, naming him Eight.
events.quote: she bonded with Realmbreaker, naming him "Eight".

events.summary: Wrenn and Eight reached Zhalfir and began to swap its place in the Multiverse with New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Together, Wrenn and Eight reached Zhalfir

events.summary: The Omenpaths left open let Giada and other angels of Capenna fly out to help; Wrenn died from the strain.
events.quote: Wrenn passed away from the strain of wielding Eight's power

relations.note: Bonded partners; she calls him Eight.
relations.quote: He became the new partner of Wrenn after the death of Seven
as the son of the World Tree

relations.note: She planned to use him to expand New Phyrexia.
relations.quote: Elesh Norn planned to use him to expand New Phyrexia across the Multiverse .
The Gatewatch planned to destroy Realmbreaker with Saheeli Rai's Filigree Sylex .

relations.note: Stopped him from detonating the Sylex.
relations.quote: but was stopped by Elspeth Tirel .
